flags: WATERFRONT: stored lakeview kept. The FS page says 'Half of the campsites are on the two non-motorized lakes' and 'many waterfront camping sites'; rec.gov tags 4, 5, 7, 17, 19, 21-24, 27, 30, 31, 33 and 34 'Lakefront'. On Esri imagery the whole campground is under continuous mixed forest; the White Deer Lake row sits ~40-60 m from the shore by the catalog points (23 45.90267,-88.96356 ~40 m; 30 45.90160,-88.96302 ~45 m; 31 ~45 m (tent); 33 45.90112,-88.96302 ~40 m; 34 ~55 m; 5 ~65 m; 4 ~90 m), with a wooded strip between. rec.gov photos of 5, 7, 17, 23, 30 and 33 show dense trunks with the water only glimpsed through them. A contrary claim, but the evidence supports a view, not frontage.
